sheets_hint: New orders are added to your sheet automatically every 5 minutes, and each row is colored by its status. Changing the status from the dropdown in the sheet updates the store right away. (Changing the status in the dashboard does not update the sheet.)
sheets_local_warning: This is a local address — Google's servers can't reach it. Use the public API URL (https://...).
sheets_generate_hint: Creates an API key named "Google Sheets" valid for one year and puts it in the script. To stop syncing, revoke the key in the API keys tab.
sheets_key_warning: The script contains a secret key and won't be shown again — copy it now and don't share it.
sheets_step_1: Open a new (or existing) Google Sheets file.
sheets_step_2: In the menu: Extensions → Apps Script.
sheets_step_3: Delete the existing code, paste the script, and save.
sheets_step_4: Pick the setup function at the top, click Run, and allow the permissions.
sheets_step_5: Back in the sheet: the orders tab appears, plus an "MD Store" menu to sync now.
sheets_toast_failed: Failed to update the status in the store
apikeys_hint: Use an API key to connect your account to Claude via MCP. A key only works for listing and creating stores, and creating products and landing pages.
apikeys_new_warning: Copy this key now and store it somewhere safe. It will not be shown again.
apikeys_revoke_confirm: Revoke this key? Any connection using it will stop working immediately.
